# JW Painting & Epoxy Flooring

> Owner-led painting, flooring, epoxy coating and repair contractor serving Jacksonville and Northeast Florida. Owner: Jimmie Wilson, with more than 30 years of hands-on finishing experience. Formerly ProFinish Paint & Epoxy LLC. Call (904) 233-2110, Mon–Sat 7 AM–8 PM (Sunday closed).

One crew handles connected work: repair the drywall, paint the room, install the floor or coat the garage. A surface problem is easier to price after it is seen, so call or request an estimate and describe the job.

## Services

- [Painting](https://jwpaintingandepoxy.com/services/painting/): interior and exterior painting, drywall repair, texture, cabinets, trim and surface preparation.
- [Flooring installation](https://jwpaintingandepoxy.com/services/flooring/): LVP and LVT, porcelain and ceramic tile, engineered and solid hardwood, laminate, damaged-floor replacement, rental-property and fast move-in flooring.
- [Epoxy and concrete coatings](https://jwpaintingandepoxy.com/services/epoxy-coatings/): garage flake and polyaspartic systems, commercial epoxy, pool-deck and patio/lanai coatings, epoxy repair and recoats.
- [Surface preparation and repairs](https://jwpaintingandepoxy.com/services/prep-repairs/): water-damaged flooring, buckled or cupped floor repair, cracked tile.
- [Vinyl and VCT floor protection](https://jwpaintingandepoxy.com/vinyl-vct-floor-protection/): Rockhard T900 clear-coat protection for compatible vinyl, linoleum and VCT floors only (not a garage-epoxy topcoat; surface and product fit are checked first).
- [All services](https://jwpaintingandepoxy.com/services/)

## Service area

Jacksonville and Northeast Florida: Duval, Clay, Nassau, Baker and northern St. Johns counties. See [service areas](https://jwpaintingandepoxy.com/service-areas/).

## Appreciation discount

10% for seniors, military members and veterans, law enforcement, firefighters and emergency service members. Mention it when requesting an estimate.
